mechanism_narrative: ERBB2-FGFR2 forced-proximity novokine with GS_med linker (~20 Å) biases signaling by enabling transphosphorylation between ERBB2 and FGFR2 kinase domains, which recruits SHC1-GRB2-SOS1 and FRS2-GAB1-PI3K adaptor complexes to drive MAPK/ERK and PI3K/AKT pathways. PLCG1 is sterically excluded due to the ~275 aa ECD asymmetry (ERBB2 ECD=630 aa vs FGFR2 ECD=355 aa) creating a geometry where PLCG1 cannot productively dock at the co-clustered intracellular domains, analogous to the H2F exemplar. This biased output shifts aged muscle toward a younger transcriptional phenotype by upregulating proliferation/survival genes (MYC, CCND1, DUSP6, ETV4) and downregulating senescence/inflammatory markers (TXNIP, IL32, S100A4, LGALS3).
